name: Geoffroy Lamarche
description: NIWA marine geologist and seabed mapping contributor, documented in 2003 and 2018.
story: Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Geoffroy Lamarche as an author of “Mapping the ocean floor”.

The December 2003 NIWA publication by Yves Le Gonidec, Geoffroy Lamarche and Ian Wright documents research that used multibeam sonar returns and Cook Strait seafloor samples to distinguish sediment types and evaluate seabed composition. It identifies Lamarche as based at NIWA in Wellington and describes open-source processing extensions for analysing backscatter. His documented New Zealand marine geospatial work therefore predates the Seabed 2030 paper listed at GeoCart 2018.
